# id: PG-gate-83-balance-engineering
# covers: PG 185 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# gate: validation gate (RUN_ORDER.md): g1 skill 25 gear none, g2 skill 25 gear own50, g3 skill 90 gear none, g4 skill 25 gear none, same fixture and method as the matrix file
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: per window a fresh Small Shack construction site (harness construct: unfinished, materials in, BUILD job)
#   next to Beaks, built for 5 game minutes at speed 10; result = construction progress (0..1).
#   The site is removed after each window (unbuild).
# verify: progress > 0 and < 1 in every window (1 = saturated: tell the PG agent to shorten the window or
#   pick a bigger building; the construct reply shows build_hours). own50 > none = building reads the
#   hooked Engineering.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
pg_formulas off ~ formulaScaling=0
wake Avarek
pin Avarek ~ pinned
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 30 ~ moved=1
give Beaks "Iron Hat" 1
equip Beaks "Iron Hat"
pg_info Beaks "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- g1: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Beaks engineering 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Beaks engineering ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@set P0 construct Beaks "Small Shack" dist 12 ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering
@set P1 construction "Small Shack" ~ progress=([-\d.]+) complete=0
@echo BAL2,185,engineering,25,0,none,g1,construct,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
clearjobs Beaks
unbuild "Small Shack"
hunger Beaks 280
# --- g2: skill 25, gear own50 ---
setstat Beaks engineering 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Beaks "Iron Hat" engineering 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Beaks engineering ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@set P0 construct Beaks "Small Shack" dist 12 ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering
@set P1 construction "Small Shack" ~ progress=([-\d.]+) complete=0
@echo BAL2,185,engineering,25,50,own50,g2,construct,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
clearjobs Beaks
unbuild "Small Shack"
hunger Beaks 280
# --- g3: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Beaks engineering 90
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Beaks engineering ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@set P0 construct Beaks "Small Shack" dist 12 ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering
@set P1 construction "Small Shack" ~ progress=([-\d.]+) complete=0
@echo BAL2,185,engineering,90,0,none,g3,construct,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
clearjobs Beaks
unbuild "Small Shack"
hunger Beaks 280
# --- g4: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Beaks engineering 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Beaks engineering ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@set P0 construct Beaks "Small Shack" dist 12 ~ progress=([-\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 10 hold
@wait-game 5 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks engineering
@set P1 construction "Small Shack" ~ progress=([-\d.]+) complete=0
@echo BAL2,185,engineering,25,0,none,g4,construct,T${T0}_${T1},${P0},${P1}
pg_statprobe read
clearjobs Beaks
unbuild "Small Shack"
hunger Beaks 280
